verdict.rationale: Docusaurus content lives as Markdown/MDX source files that you write yourself, and it builds them into plain static HTML in a local `build` directory deployable to any static host (Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages, etc.). CommonMark can be opted into, the project is MIT-licensed, and community users report migrating away (e.g., to fumadocs), so there is no lock-in to 'export' from. Missing for 10: no documented export or portability guidance, MDX/JSX-embedded React components reduce portability to plain Markdown tools (e.g., Typora lacks MDX support), and there is no PDF or other alternate-format export.
